_doc: Coordinates: x/z are LOCAL to the trap cell (0..19). y is RELATIVE to the floor-top block: rel 0 = the top floor block (absolute floor_y), rel 1 = standing level on the flat floor. A start y is the FEET block (tp y = floor_y + rel). Absolute cell origin = origin + (col,row)*cell.size.

traps.name: pit2x2_3
traps.needs: jump spam fails (3 up); needs place-block-under/pillar or dig staircase

traps.name: pit1x1_3
traps.needs: pillar up (place blocks) or dig a staircase

traps.name: pit1x1_6_walls
traps.desc: 1x1 pit, 6 deep, plus a 2-high stone collar around the opening (8 blocks to climb).
traps.needs: pillar up 8 blocks (requires blocks, e.g. from digging the walls)

traps.name: lava_ring
traps.desc: 3x3 stone island at floor level inside a 3-wide lava ring (lava 2 deep). Island is the start.
traps.needs: bridge with placed blocks (no swimming/jumping across); lava contact is a failure

traps.name: cobweb_room
traps.desc: 5x5x3 room filled with cobweb, stone shell, one 1x2 doorway on the west wall (x=6,z=9).
traps.needs: cut cobweb (sword/shears or slow break) toward the door; stuck-in-web slowdown

traps.name: powder_snow_pit
traps.desc: 3x3 pit 3 deep completely filled with powder snow (bot sinks in without leather boots; freezes).
traps.needs: jump out of powder snow / place blocks; freezing damage while inside

traps.name: water_column
traps.desc: 1x1 shaft, water from rel -6 to rel 3 (10 deep), 3-high stone collar so the water surface is flush with the collar top.
traps.needs: swim up (jump held) and climb out over the collar edge; drowning is the failure mode

traps.name: trapdoor_cell
traps.desc: 1x1 cell, 2 high, sunk in the floor (air rel -1..0), lid is a closed oak trapdoor (top half) flush with the floor.
traps.needs: open the trapdoor (use block), then place a block under / pillar to get out (2 up)

traps.name: stone_box
traps.desc: Fully enclosed 3x3x3 hollow stone box (shell 1 thick); the roof is a single block layer above the interior (exit above = dig it).
traps.needs: dig up (pickaxe) the roof block, then pillar up to leave; canDig must be allowed in unstuck mode

traps.name: thrash
traps.desc: 10x10 field of fences, walls, slabs, stairs, panes, gates and trapdoors (deterministic, seed 7); start in a clear centre cell.
traps.needs: pathfinding through awkward collision shapes without oscillating; exit to any side counts
